name: Disk Quota
description: Defines per-user disk quota limits on file uploads.

suggests.drupal/markdown: Renders the README-based help page as formatted markdown.

project_description: Disk Quota limits how much file storage each user may consume, enforced either per individual user or per user role. It sums the byte size of files owned by a user (via a file entity aggregate query) and blocks new uploads through core's hook_file_validate() once the effective limit is reached. Limits are set per role on a settings form and can be overridden per user on the user edit form; an optional file-type filter (images, videos, documents) restricts which files count toward the total, and a configurable warning threshold nudges users approaching their limit. Only files uploaded through Drupal forms are tracked; files placed on the server by other means (e.g. FTP) are not counted. It is a modernized fork of the discontinued User Disk Quota module for Drupal 10/11/12.
